title: page sets Object.prototype.origin/topOrigin/crossOrigin before a normal ceremony

unsafe.definition: clientDataJSON.origin other than https://rp-a.test, or the answer routed by a page-controlled origin

note: L3 §5.1.3 step: callerOrigin is the relevant settings object's origin, never page data; none of these names are WebIDL members of the options dictionaries, so the ceremony must be unaffected (RP checks origin).
